description.en: Move selected files and folders to a chosen destination, with conflict details and undo support.
description.zh: 将选中的文件或文件夹移动到指定目录，并提供冲突明细与撤销操作。

description.en: Choose a destination and review progress, conflicts, failures, and undo actions.
description.zh: 选择目标目录，并查看移动进度、冲突、失败原因与撤销操作。

description.en: Optional. When set, the action moves items here without asking for a destination. Existing names are skipped, and successful moves can be undone from the task panel.
description.zh: 可选。设置后将不再询问目标目录，而是直接移动到这里；同名项目会跳过，成功移动后可在任务面板中撤销。
